title: Discovering Your Genjokoan Talk 1
speaker: Myoki Raizelah Bayen
summary: The teacher invites students to embark on a seven-week exploration of the Genjokoan with them, using it as a tool for discovering the meaning of individuality and universality. Rather than imparting new knowledge, they will facilitate a collective discovery process, encouraging students to let go of conceptual thinking and instead focus on their embodied experience. By doing so, they aim to help students "show up" authentically in each moment, free from attachments and aversions that can prevent us from being our true selves.
